sources.title: Versailles: French Revolution to interwar period

events.title: French Revolution begins
events.description: The revolutionary period in France begins in 1789.

events.title: Storming of the Bastille
events.description: Parisian insurgents seize the Bastille.

events.title: First French Republic established
events.description: The Convention establishes the French Republic.

events.title: Execution of Louis XVI
events.description: Louis XVI is executed in Paris.

events.title: Reign of Terror
events.description: A period of revolutionary repression and political violence.

events.title: Fall of Robespierre
events.description: Robespierre is overthrown during the Thermidorian Reaction.

events.title: French Directory established
events.description: The Directory becomes France's executive government.

events.title: Napoleon's first Italian campaign
events.description: Bonaparte commands the Army of Italy.

events.title: Coup of 18 Brumaire
events.description: The coup overthrows the Directory and brings Napoleon to power.

events.title: French Consulate established
events.description: The Consulate replaces the Directory; Napoleon becomes First Consul.

events.title: Napoleonic Code promulgated
events.description: France promulgates the Civil Code.

events.title: Napoleon becomes Emperor
events.description: Napoleon assumes the title Emperor of the French.

events.title: Battle of Austerlitz
events.description: Napoleon defeats Russian and Austrian forces.

events.title: Peninsular War begins
events.description: War begins in the Iberian Peninsula against Napoleonic occupation.

events.title: French invasion of Russia
events.description: Napoleon's Grande Armée invades the Russian Empire.

events.title: Napoleon's first abdication
events.description: Napoleon abdicates and is exiled to Elba.

events.title: Bourbon Restoration begins
events.description: Louis XVIII enters Paris as the monarchy is restored.

events.title: Congress of Vienna
events.description: European powers negotiate a post-Napoleonic settlement.

events.title: Hundred Days
events.description: Napoleon briefly returns to power.

events.title: Battle of Waterloo
events.description: Napoleon is defeated by the allied armies at Waterloo.

events.title: July Revolution
events.description: Revolution overthrows Charles X in France.

events.title: French Revolution of 1848
events.description: Revolution ends the July Monarchy and establishes the Second Republic.

mechanisms.title: Coup removes Directory government
mechanisms.reason: The institutional source identifies the coup as overthrowing the Directory and installing the Consulate.

mechanisms.title: Consular power is a modeled prerequisite to Napoleon's imperial accession
mechanisms.reason: The sequence is documented, but counterfactual necessity is a model assumption.

mechanisms.title: Consular reform context supports Civil Code
mechanisms.reason: The Code belongs to Napoleon's reform program; exclusive counterfactual dependence is uncertain.

mechanisms.title: Imperial war and Russian campaign precede first abdication
mechanisms.reason: The source links continual wars to imperial weakening; this grouping is an explicit model simplification.

mechanisms.title: Hundred Days enables Waterloo campaign
mechanisms.reason: Waterloo occurred during Napoleon's Hundred Days return.
